Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the college board to act as a clearinghouse for state and federal financial aid.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to centralizing financial aid administration forcommunity and technical colleges; and adding a new section to chapter28B.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The college board shall act as a clearinghouse for all stateand federal financial aid awarded to students in the state's communityand technical college system and shall be the single point of contactfor all community or technical college students applying for financialaid. The college board shall develop standardized informationalmaterial and application procedures that are accessible in written formand through a college board web site. (2) By August 2012, all financial aid functions performed byindividual college districts shall be transferred to the college board. (3) The college board shall disclose all information necessary forcompliance with RCW 28B.15.0681 and 28B.76.300(4) to each college p. 1 SB 5462district.
